metadata.datasource: HARMAN/ILFORD MULTIGRADE RC PAPERS, October 2020; https://www.ilfordphoto.com/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/MULTIGRADE-RC-Papers-J20.pdf; SHA256 62c93069b0ae5dc340444651dbbe8e1b17102f7e25f12449297504a8e1d391e1. Reproduce with scripts/bw_expansion/prepare.py; source points, assumptions and conditions: data/profile-sources/bw-expansion/recipe.json. Unit sensitivity on 380-550 nm, zero elsewhere: a neutral-negative integration weight, NOT a digitisation of the unscaled Ilford spectral plot. Cancels algebraically for spectrally neutral negatives under normalized print exposure. No calibrated colour-negative printing, absolute paper speed, spectral filtration, or continuously variable contrast claim.
